summary: Closure review: the authors have addressed the three required revisions from the previous terminal review (concise evidence-to-claim mapping, nearest-work comparison, and compression of provenance into compact manifest pointers). The manuscript transparently reports the preregistration, execution artifacts, and the degenerate null outcome produced under shared-generation semantics. No new critical scientific defects are introduced. I recommend finalisation after the minor optional cleanups below.
optional_revisions: Mechanically verify and state in the manuscript that the compiled PDF is ≤5 pages and that the Disclosure Statement appears within pages 1–5 (use archived compilation log if available).
Optionally add (brief) cluster-stratified acceptance rates table (1 row per cluster) drawn from execution/task_manifest.jsonl to make the claim of cluster-level 100% acceptance easier to scan.

Tighten a few provenance sentences further (very short pointers to execution/execution_manifest.json and the full hash manifest) to improve readability for reviewers unfamiliar with heavy artifact appendices.
